title: New Zealand household net worth and mortgage interest rates
licence: Numerical values cited as facts with attribution; no text, figures or datasets reproduced.

sources.citation: Stats NZ (26 Sep 2025). Household net worth statistics: Year ended June 2024 (Household Economic Survey), Key facts, stats.govt.nz/information-releases/household-net-worth-statistics-year-ended-june-2024/, retrieved 2026-10-15 (rendered page).

Reserve Bank of New Zealand, statistics series B30, New residential mortgage weighted average interest rates (simple average of the month's new lending), rbnz.govt.nz/statistics/series/exchange-and-interest-rates/new-residential-mortgage-weighted-average-interest-rates, April 2026 column, retrieved 2026-10-15. The bank's site refuses automated readers, so the table was read from a search engine's indexed copy of the page.

items.description: Median net worth of New Zealand households, year ended June 2024
items.note: "the median net worth of New Zealand households was $529,000, up 33 percent from $399,000 in the year ended June 2021"; largely owner-occupied dwellings and other real estate, so as money in the bank it is a deviation (D61).

items.description: Weighted average interest rate on new residential mortgage lending, two-year fixed, April 2026
items.note: B30 April 2026: floating 5.54%, one year 4.52%, two years 4.82% (up from 4.54% in January 2026). Medium because read from an indexed copy, not the bank's own page.
